body: SHANKPIT commits 2ca3995 (feat), edd899d (CLAUDE.md standing-commit note). Wires previously-dormant server/system/vehicle_dynamics.go/vehicle_physics.go chassis into a live game mode for the first time via new server/system/racing_mode.go. One F1 vehicle, one hand-authored track (SCENE_RACE_TRACK), 8 checkpoints, 3 laps, 3 items + 1 ultimate. New PACKET_RACING_STATE wire packet. Client: R keybind + HUD, plus a net_connect() fix (previously missing mode byte, also fixes CTF-over-network as a side effect). Full spec + known gaps (apps2/lobby's pre-existing unrelated build breakage) in docs2/specs/BEDROCK_RACERS_SPEC.md. go test ./... green. Filed retroactively — this Apple should have been posted the same night the work landed, before the backlog-first discipline was tightened; found during a full-session audit.
title: Bedrock Racers vertical slice — F1 chassis + item/ultimate layer (retroactive)
